signs.title: Fuchsia City
lines: Fuchsia City — gardens, sea breezes and a love of Pokémon.
East: Route 15. West: Route 18. South: Route 19.
The Safari Zone entrance is in the north of the city.

signs.title: Fuchsia City Pokémon Gym
lines: Leader: Koga — a specialist in Poison-type Pokémon.
A calm mind and careful preparation are a trainer’s best defense.

signs.title: Safari Zone
lines: The Safari Zone is currently closed.
Please speak to the attendant in the gatehouse for information.
